name: Elephant Intrusion Detection System
jurisdiction: India; Northeast Frontier and other railway corridors
selection_rationale: Railway tender and specification offer distinct pre-award and acceptance stages alongside a ministerial report of implementation.
change_in_understanding: A 141 route-km implementation claim and a 981 route-km award claim are now separately traceable; the 5% false-alarm ceiling remains a requirement, not a result.
coverage_limit: Award documents, purchase orders, completed six-month trial results and a dated commissioning certificate were not established in the reviewed subset.

name: Railway Video Surveillance System (VSS) AI analytics
selection_rationale: Named station tender, component-integration invitation, issuer project page and stock-exchange press filing provide procurement and rollout anchors.
change_in_understanding: Intellve is an invited bidder for a specific integration, not an established national VSS supplier; 2,077 commissioned stations is an undated issuer claim.
coverage_limit: No original national supplier award, dated nationwide AI/FRS activation inventory, independent accuracy results or AI-specific redress procedure was established.
baseline_stage: Official coverage reported; station configuration unverified

name: NHAI Dashcam Analytics Services (DAS)
selection_rationale: TCIL's 2025 EOI reproduces the NHAI RFP, allowing requirements to be compared with the 2026 announcements.
change_in_understanding: A procurement pathway predates the March 2026 announcement. Weekly surveys, model assessment, report correction and masking are required; June's initiated rollout is not complete coverage.
coverage_limit: No selected backend partner, awarded DAS contract, payment record, acceptance test result or measured defect-detection performance was established.

name: Adalat AI court-assistance family
selection_rationale: Named High Court direction and district-court training packet expose mandated use, exceptions, reporting and supplier-labelled preparation.
change_in_understanding: The direction permits reasoned manual exceptions and mandates monthly use reports. A scheduled refresher programme does not demonstrate attendance or statewide courtroom use.
coverage_limit: Foundation and private-limited company names are not resolved into one legal entity; original agreement, fees, monthly use reports and evaluation results remain unverified.
baseline_stage: Court order mandates rollout from 1 October 2026; actual courtroom coverage not established

name: CAG AI-PARAS pension pre-scrutiny
selection_rationale: The common CAG sovereign-AI EOI names the existing agent family; office orders and conference minutes provide institutional context.
change_in_understanding: POC weighting, human final authority and controlled India-based infrastructure are proposed procurement requirements. Institutional AI directions do not establish PARAS production use.
coverage_limit: No signed platform contract, named successful supplier, agent-specific acceptance testing or pension-decision outcome audit was established.
baseline_stage: May 2026 EOI describes existing targeted application and intended agentic commissioning; accepted upgrade unverified

name: CAG Parakh document/image analytics
selection_rationale: The same CAG EOI names PARAKH; contextual audit orders are retained without counting a second independent procurement.
change_in_understanding: The same platform's POC and human-in-the-loop requirements can be inspected for this family, without treating shared documents as independent corroboration.
coverage_limit: No signed platform contract, named successful supplier, PARAKH-specific operational inventory or completed independent outcome evaluation was established.
baseline_stage: February 2026 office order refers to AI tool in data-led audit presentation

name: Safe Kerala AI traffic enforcement
selection_rationale: Original administrative sanction and Keltron's implementation account add conditional funding, procurement-history and review-workflow evidence.
change_in_understanding: The sanction establishes authorised costs and monitoring-linked instalments, not spending. SRIT's award and SLA are Keltron's account, not an inspected original award or contract.
coverage_limit: Payment ledgers, monitoring reports, original supplier award/SLA, a current activation inventory and affected-person appeal rules remain unverified; Malayalam extraction is damaged.
baseline_stage: Challan processing reported suspended in September

name: UPSC face authentication
selection_rationale: The 2024 tender/correction can be contrasted with 2026 face-authentication reports and NeGD technical-support attribution.
change_in_understanding: Tender retention/SOP provisions are not silently applied to the later mobile application. Scale and timing are official claims, not recognition-accuracy evidence.
coverage_limit: A continuity link from the 2024 procurement to the 2026 app, successful bidder/contract, mismatch SOP, denial statistics and face-specific appeal handling were not established.

name: Madukkarai AI elephant-warning system
selection_rationale: Tamil Nadu launch release and forest policy note supply sanction, site, control-room and alert-chain evidence.
change_in_understanding: Rs 724 lakh is a sanction, not spending; 12 towers and alerts to locomotive pilots are reported implementation, not independently tested incident prevention.
coverage_limit: Original tender, supplier award, expenditure record, alert logs and an independent false-alarm or collision-outcome evaluation were not established.

name: CPGRAMS Intelligent Grievance Management System (IGMS)
selection_rationale: Legacy implementation documents are linked to the NextGen CPGRAMS RFP, pre-bid clarifications and later status without merging versions.
change_in_understanding: Manual closure, isolated LLM processing and legacy-data training provisions become inspectable. Official 2022 and September 2023 launch descriptions remain unresolved; NextGen was still described as under development in August 2026.
coverage_limit: Successful NextGen bidder/contract, acceptance/go-live record, classifier performance and AI-specific appeals remain unverified; general portal/privacy routes are context, not model-specific safeguards.
